text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...There aren't any. None at all! 
No rugged crags, no roaring waterfall 
basins...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
How on earth am I supposed to— 
how am I supposed to slim down like 
this...?!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
They're right here. Both the crags and the 
waterfall basins.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
? But isn't this place just an amusement 
center...?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
On the surface, yeah. 
Try swimming over by the fountain.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! This surge— 
it's just like the churning currents of a 
waterfall basin!!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now go give that bouldering wall 
over there a shot.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Gh! The texture of the stone is 
different, 
but the strain on my body feels just like 
scaling a cliff!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To think the city would have places like 
this. 
It kind of brings back memories!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you don't need to feel out of place 
in the city. 
What we do here hasn't changed a bit from 
back then.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Using whatever's around you. 
That's what we've always done, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From then on, Daring Tact frequented the 
recreation center, 
successfully dropping the extra weight in 
no time!
